title: TestsManifest
description: Runner-owned sidecar at .state/tests_manifest.json recording, per Build phase, a digest of the frozen acceptance suite (tests/acceptance/phase_<N>/) at the N.tests commit. The hard CLOSE acceptance-suite integrity invariant (D-tests-4 part 2, FU-43) recomputes the digest at CLOSE and fails the iteration if it changed. Absent file / phase entry ⇒ the check is skipped.
